question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing fullback, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing center midfielder, Dave is playing right winger, Eve is playing left back, Fred is playing left winger, and Gertrude is playing right back.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Dave trade positions. Finally, Dave and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) fullback
(B) cheerleader
(C) center midfielder
(D) right winger
(E) left back
(F) left winger
(G) right back
solution:
Positions in each row are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: (fullback, cheerleader, center midfielder, right winger, left back, left winger, right back)
1. Dave and Gertrude swap: (fullback, cheerleader, center midfielder, right back, left back, left winger, right winger)
2. Gertrude and Alice swap: (right winger, cheerleader, center midfielder, right back, left back, left winger, fullback)
3. Alice and Gertrude swap: (fullback, cheerleader, center midfielder, right back, left back, left winger, right winger)
4. Gertrude and Bob swap: (fullback, right winger, center midfielder, right back, left back, left winger, cheerleader)
5. Claire and Gertrude swap: (fullback, right winger, cheerleader, right back, left back, left winger, center midfielder)
6. Eve and Dave swap: (fullback, right winger, cheerleader, left back, right back, left winger, center midfielder)
7. Dave and Bob swap: (fullback, left back, cheerleader, right winger, right back, left winger, center midfielder)
Gertrude is playing center midfielder, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
